items.title: Projects redesigned: from folder to conversation
items.category: AIエージェント・コーディング・長時間ワークフロー
items.excerpt: Claude Code Projects beta now coordinates multiple cloud-session threads: it scopes work, delegates parallel tasks, reviews outputs and assembles results. Each thread runs on its own branch/repo copy, can open PRs and run tests, and contributes to shared project memory.
items.query: AI agent coding enterprise September 17 2026 official long-running projects

items.title: Claude Cowork and chat are now one Claude
items.category: AIエージェント・業務効率化・企業AI
items.excerpt: Anthropic is merging Claude Cowork and chat into one experience that can continue delegated work after a user closes the laptop. The rollout starts on Pro and Max; Claude Docs and Claude Slides are also launching in beta on paid plans, with Enterprise admin controls.
items.query: AI agent enterprise workflow automation September 16 2026 official

items.title: How Claude is uplifting biomolecular modeling
items.category: Scientific AI・バイオ・研究自動化
items.excerpt: Anthropic reports an internal general-purpose research model optimized 30+ open-source biomolecular models in under four weeks, yielding roughly 4x average speedups with minimal precision loss. It also built a low-memory mode for >10,000-token biomolecular systems on one NVIDIA GPU node; optimized code is open-sourced.
items.query: scientific AI research automation biology model optimization September 17 2026 official

items.title: Our framework for reporting model misalignment
items.category: AI安全性・評価・エージェント
items.excerpt: OpenAI published a framework for tracking, investigating and disclosing model misalignment, accompanied by six reports from the prior six months. The framework is intended to accelerate disclosure of unexpected behavior even before root causes or mitigations are fully understood.
items.query: AI safety model misalignment framework September 16 2026 official

items.title: Mila and Mozilla announce new initiative to build trustworthy open source AI for everyone, with Canadian government support
items.category: オープンウェイト・OSS・Sovereign AI
items.excerpt: Mozilla and Mila announced an open-source AI foundation layer intended for locally operated systems with organizational control of technology and data. Mozilla committed an initial $5M and Hypertec $1M for the first year; Mila will lead technical delivery with Canadian government support.
items.query: open source AI foundation sovereign local deployment September 17 2026 official

items.title: Introducing System One Models and Jev
items.category: 最新AIモデル・AI-native SaaS・業務自動化
items.excerpt: TypeSafe AI introduced a System One model class for fast structured decisions consumed directly by software, using typed probabilistic outputs instead of free-form text, plus the Jev automation system. Performance and cost comparisons on the launch page are vendor-reported.
items.query: latest AI model structured decisions automation September 2026 startup

items.title: Introducing Gemini 3.8 Live and 3.8 Live Extended Thinking
items.category: 最新AIモデル・Voice Agent・Multimodal
items.excerpt: Google introduced Gemini 3.8 Live and 3.8 Live Extended Thinking for near-real-time multimodal dialogue. The first targets scaled conversational/visual-grounded workloads; Extended Thinking targets higher-complexity multi-step reasoning and production voice-agent use cases.
items.query: frontier model voice agent multimodal September 2026 official release

items.title: Siemens and Salesforce Deepen AI Partnership to Redefine Industrial Sales and Service
items.category: PLM・デジタルツイン・AIエージェント・Industrial AI
items.excerpt: Siemens and Salesforce are integrating Agentforce with Teamcenter Service Lifecycle Management so agents can bring engineering-grade digital-twin information into sales and service workflows. Siemens also describes two Agentforce agents qualifying inbound leads for 18,000 sellers.
items.query: industrial AI agent PLM digital twin Teamcenter September 2026 official

items.title: Fujitsu Pioneers Agentic IT transformation with ‘Aurora’ omni-channel AI Workplace Agent
items.category: AIエージェント・企業AI・RAG
items.excerpt: Fujitsu launched Agentic Service Desk powered by Aurora, a multilingual voice AI agent for end-to-end IT issue resolution. Its architecture combines voice, multimodal RAG and an AI orchestrator, with HITL safeguards for critical decisions and integrations including ServiceNow and AWS Connect.
items.query: Japan Europe enterprise AI agents workplace RAG September 2026 official

items.title: Siemens and Procter & Gamble roll out AI-based quality inspection worldwide
items.category: 製造・Industrial AI・Edge AI
items.excerpt: P&G is expanding a Siemens industrial-AI and edge-computing inspection system across manufacturing operations worldwide. Siemens reports 10–20% lower scrap depending on product and commissioning 5–10x faster than traditional bespoke vision systems; these performance figures are vendor-reported.
items.query: manufacturing AI quality inspection edge September 16 2026 official

items.title: CADSplat: Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting Aided by CAD Models for Robust, Photorealistic Digital-Twin Reconstruction
items.category: CAD・デジタルツイン・3D Reconstruction
items.excerpt: CADSplat regularizes 3D Gaussian Splatting with an explicit CAD shape prior to reconstruct digital twins from fewer than 15 wide-baseline views. Across two real-world datasets, the authors report better results than evaluated baselines and graceful degradation to as few as three views.
items.query: CAD digital twin reconstruction AI September 2026 arxiv

items.title: LimiX-2: A Contextual Mechanism Network Towards General Structured-Data Intelligence
items.category: 最新AIモデル・Structured Data・Foundation Model
items.excerpt: LimiX-2 is a foundation model for structured/tabular data based on Contextual Mechanism Networks and context-conditional masked modeling. The authors report results on TabArena, TALENT and BCCO and analyze whether learned attention recovers causal skeleton structure; benchmark claims are author-reported.
items.query: latest foundation model structured data September 2026 arxiv

items.title: Agentic Societies Need a Social Harness
items.category: MCP/Agent Protocol・Multi-Agent・安全性
items.excerpt: The paper studies autonomous agents coordinating across trust boundaries and reports failures even among honest agents plus exploitability by faulty or malicious peers. It proposes a layered 'social harness' for preventive controls, runtime message validation and post-event investigation.
items.query: multi-agent protocol trust boundaries safety September 2026 arxiv

items.title: AgentLSD: Evaluating AI Security Agents Under Adversarial Task Contamination
items.category: AI安全性・Benchmark・Agent Security
items.excerpt: AgentLSD evaluates six models on 11 web CTF challenges with clean versus trap-contaminated evidence. Agents captured 41% of flags in clean conditions; traps added about 20 turns and 2k reasoning tokens even when successful. The framework, trap specs and raw traces are released.
items.query: AI agent security benchmark adversarial task contamination September 2026 arxiv

items.title: Flag Game: A Toy Model for Mechanistic Swarm Interpretability
items.category: AI安全性・Multi-Agent・Interpretability
items.excerpt: Flag Game models collective belief formation among communicating agents. The authors observe non-monotonic performance with population size, collapse at small populations and polarization at larger ones, and introduce social circuit attribution plus a statistical-mechanics model of group behavior.
items.query: multi-agent safety interpretability September 2026 arxiv

items.title: Robust and Efficient AI Frameworks for Scalable Material Design and Property Prediction
items.category: Scientific AI・材料・生成設計
items.excerpt: This thesis unifies graph pretraining, multimodal crystal representations and generative modeling for materials design. It includes TGDMat, a text-guided joint diffusion model for lattice parameters, atomic types and coordinates, alongside data-efficient crystal-property predictors.
items.query: materials AI generative design property prediction September 2026 arxiv

items.title: LLMs as Master Forgers: Generating Synthetic Time Series Data for Manufacturing
items.category: 製造・RAG/Data・Synthetic Data
items.excerpt: The paper fine-tunes LLMs on manufacturing process instructions and adds RAG to generate synthetic manufacturing time series. Evaluation uses statistical metrics, PCA and anomaly-detection downstream tasks against ARIMA and LSTM baselines; the reported improvements are author-reported.
items.query: manufacturing AI synthetic time series RAG September 2026 arxiv

items.title: Gartner Forecasts Worldwide AI Spending to Grow 49.5% in 2026
items.category: 企業AI・Spending・AI Infrastructure調査
items.excerpt: Gartner forecasts worldwide AI spending at about $2.67T in 2026, up 49.5% year over year, with AI infrastructure about $1.48T. Its current forecast raises 2026 growth for AI application-development platforms from 28% to 39%. These are Gartner forecast figures, not observed spending.

items.title: Gartner Survey Finds Only 22% of Organizations Have Successfully Scaled AI Across Multiple Business Units
items.category: 企業AI・Adoption・ROI/Scale調査
items.excerpt: Gartner surveyed 1,303 respondents at organizations with at least $50M annual revenue during Jan–Apr 2026. It reports 22% had scaled AI across multiple business units or adopted an AI-first approach; 85% of functional leaders planned higher 2026 AI spending after allocating 12% of function budgets on average in 2025.
items.query: AI adoption scaling enterprise survey September 2026 Gartner

items.title: Gartner Survey Finds 93% of Audit Functions Use AI, but 60% Lack a Formal Strategy
items.category: 企業AI・Adoption・ROI調査
items.excerpt: A May 2026 Gartner webinar poll of 161 chief audit executives found 93% reported some AI use, while 60% lacked a formal AI strategy. Gartner also reports 54% had not begun measuring AI ROI and only 15% had implemented defined, organized AI use cases.
items.query: enterprise AI adoption ROI survey September 2026 audit

items.category: Edge AI・Local AI・AIエージェント

items.category: Scientific AI・オープンモデル・Foundation Model

items.title: OpenEarthAgent: A Unified Framework for Tool-Augmented Geospatial Agents
items.category: Scientific AI・GeoAI・AIエージェント
items.excerpt: OpenEarthAgent trains tool-augmented geospatial agents on satellite imagery, natural-language queries and explicit reasoning traces.
